summary: 47-year-old man hiking about 10 miles into the Weminuche Wilderness in the Roelle Creek drainage near the north end of Vallecito Creek slipped and fell into the creek, possibly dislocating his shoulder; he spent the night out, activated his SPOT device, and rescuers began extraction efforts about 7:41 p.m. Monday
responding_agency: La Plata County Search and Rescue; San Juan County SAR assist
notes: Date = the Monday of publication week (snowbrains article images dated 2018/07; rescue underway as of 9:30 a.m. Tuesday, extraction method unknown; Flight for Life unavailable Monday). Surfaced via the San Juan County SAR chunk — San Juan County SAR assisted, La Plata County SAR led (Ron Corkish), county recorded La Plata.
